about: Bullfrog Creek is a taproom, so adults can sip craft beer while the kids visit Santa. The brewery's own calendar describes most of its events as free, family friendly and first come first served, and its kitchen opens daily at 11:30 AM.
Two other Bullfrog Creek events share the day on the brewery calendar: Hops N Horsepower and Santa's Gingerbread Workshop, both at noon, so expect a busy Sunday afternoon.
faq: Fun 4 Brandon Kids lists free admission for the Bullfrog Creek Christmas Market and Santa visit.
The Fun 4 Brandon Kids listing says pictures with Santa start at 1 PM.
Do I need to bring anything to the Gingerbread Workshop?
The Tampa Calendar listing says families bring their own gingerbread houses and the brewery supplies the decorating candy and icing.
Bullfrog Creek Brewing Co. is at 3632 Lithia Pinecrest Rd in Valrico.
